تفترشوا (form VIII)
# تَفْتَرِشُوا (taftarišū) /taf.ta.ri.ʃuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَرَشَ (iftaraša)
# تُفْتَرَشُوا (tuftarašū) /tuf.ta.ra.ʃuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَرَشَ (iftaraša)
